messages:
Priya: FYI customer AcmeCo is seeing a big 5xx/503 spike during their nightly inference batch, started ~23:12 UTC. They report timeouts and SDK retry loops.

Jamal: Can you drop tenant_id + sample request? any client SDK version?

Priya: tenant_id=acmeco-prod-22. Using official node SDK v1.4.2, batch job sends ~120 concurrent requests with long prompts (~16k tokens). Attached sample payload below.

Priya: ```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{ model: "redwood-large-v1", input: "<long prompt>..." }
```

support-bot: alert created: INC-2026 - Hosted inference 503 spike for acmeco-prod-22 (auto-severity: high)

Alex: Looking at edge logs now. We're seeing queue growth on the router -> upstream inference pool saturated. Upstream responses were 502/504 then the gateway returned 503s when conn queue hit limit.

Alex: Hypothesis: long-context requests cause much longer GPU time and KV cache pressure -> fewer concurrency slots. Tenant was bursty (120 concurrent) which wiped out shared pool.

Jamal: Do we have per-tenant concurrency limits configured for hosted? I thought defaults were 64 but AcmeCo's batch bypassed client-side rate limiting.

Morgan: Default admission control is 64. Looks like the batch job spiked to 120 because their orchestrator retried aggressively on client-side 5xxs (retry storm).

Alex: Repro steps I ran locally: replayed 50 long-context requests -> p95 GPU time ~4.2s, but with 120 parallel it climbs >15s and router queue >200ms leading to proxy 503 backpressure.

Alex: Quick mitigation applied: added temporary per-tenant concurrency cap=8 for acmeco-prod-22 and enabled forced fallback to redwood-medium-v1 for new requests.

deploy-bot: config update applied to routing cluster: per-tenant-cap(acmeco-prod-22)=8, fallback-policy enabled -> redwood-medium-v1

Priya: Customer update drafted: "We're applying a temporary concurrency cap and routing some requests to a faster model to restore service. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Want me to send? :email:

Sasha: Please hold until we confirm metrics. If error rate drops, we can send short comms. I'll prepare status page blurb once Jamal confirms impact.

Jamal: Metrics now: error rate for acmeco-prod-22 5xx down from 14% -> 1.3% in last 6m after cap + fallback. Latency p95 down ~40%. Good as immediate fix.

Priya: Customer acknowledged and paused batch for 20m to let queues drain. They asked for ETA for permanent fix and whether this will count as downtime on their bill.

Morgan: Billing: short mitigation not customer-visible as outage, but ask billing-team if they want to offer credit. I'll loop in finance if needed.

Alex: Next steps for eng: (1) add adaptive per-tenant admission control that looks at GPU tail latencies and reduces admission for heavy long-context workloads, (2) add better tenant-level quotas + soft backpressure to SDK, (3) optimize KV cache eviction for long-context to reduce per-request GPU time.

Jamal: I'll own a short runbook for support: detect tenant burst patterns (concurrent > threshold and long median GPU time) -> auto-apply soft cap + notify customer + optional fallback. Target PR in 5 days.

Sasha: I'll post a status page: short blurb saying "degraded performance for select customers due to high-concurrency long-context batch jobs; mitigation applied; investigating root cause." ETA 30m.

Priya: Can someone drop the exact logs we used for triage into the incident doc (INC-2026) so CS can attach to the ticket?

Alex: Done, uploaded router traces, upstream pool metrics, and the replay script to the incident doc. Also added the curl + node SDK snippet that reproduces the retry storm.

Priya: Thanks. I'll follow up with AcmeCo about batching best practices and recommend SDK throttling/backoff and the smaller model fallback as permanent options.

Jamal: Moving to status: monitoring to watch for any regression for the next 3 hours. If error rate climbs, we'll escalate to SRE for pool scaling.

Morgan: I'll coordinate with billing and CS on credit guidance if customer requests.

Sasha: Posting to status.redwood.ai now. Link will be in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Closing the Slack thread for now. Will re-open if alerts fire. Thanks everyone.
